items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: I know your brother Bill played several instruments

ctx.x: And I just want you to tell me about how you started out. I know your brother Bill played several instruments and your parents also played, right? Tell me about it. Was it an older brother?

Yes, I was the youngest of three brothers in my family. I had one sister. She was -- she's the youngest, but I was the youngest brother, and we all played, you know, as children. We took music, you know, not intending to be professional musicians, but it was just part of our education. My father studied violin but never played anyplace. He just studied and studied and played at home. And my mother, who played piano and sang in the church choir, and that's how it all began. My brother and I, we started when we…
